commands.key.close.description: Close a drop now (a raffle draws immediately)
commands.key.allow_role.description: Remove a role from the deny list
commands.key.deny_role.description: Members with this role can never claim keys
commands.key.drop.description: Open a key drop: raffle or first come first served
commands.key.list.description: Who received a key from this batch
commands.key.param_count: How many keys to hand out
commands.key.param_minutes: Raffle closes after this many minutes
commands.key.param_mode: Raffle (button signup) or first come first served (button claims)
commands.key.param_role: Only members with this role may take part
commands.key.param_team: Team id; looked up from the batch when omitted
keys.already_claimed: You already claimed from **this batch**. One key per person per batch.
keys.bad_batch: The batch id cannot be empty.
keys.bad_channel: I cannot post here: run this in a text channel or thread.
keys.claimed.title: Delivered
keys.dm_failed: I could not send you a direct message (you may have "allow DMs from server members" turned off). **The key was returned to the pool** — enable DMs and click again.
keys.drop.already_entered: You are already on the list.
keys.drop.created_body: **{count}** key(s) will go out in {channel}. Drop id `{drop}` (close early with `/key close {drop}`).
keys.drop.entered: You are on the list (number **{count}**). Winners get a DM after the deadline.
keys.drop.fcfs_body:
The first **{count}** people to click each get an activation key (sent by DM).
Who may take part: {role}
keys.drop.no_winners: Drawn: {entrants} entered, but no key could be handed out (the batch may be empty).
keys.deny.added: Added {role} to the deny list — they can no longer claim or join raffles.
keys.deny.title: Key deny list
keys.deny.unchanged: {role} was already in that state; nothing changed.
keys.drop.not_found: That drop cannot be found (the button may be stale).
keys.drop.role_denied: One of your roles is on the key deny list, so you cannot take part.
keys.drop.raffle_body:
Click the button to join. In **{minutes} minutes** I will draw **{count}** winner(s); they get a key by DM.
Who may take part: {role}
keys.drop.sent: The key was sent to you in a **direct message**. Redeem it in the Mod Manager.
keys.list.empty: No keys from this batch have been handed out by the bot yet.
keys.list.title: Deliveries for batch {batch}
keys.team_lookup_failed: Could not tell which Team batch **{batch}** belongs to (`{error}`). Usually the bot lacks `team.system.keys.read`; if you would rather not grant it, pass `team:<team_id>`.
keys.team_unknown: Could not tell which Team batch **{batch}** belongs to (the batch id may be wrong). Check it, or pass `team:<team_id>`.
modules.access_keys.description: Hand out activation keys per batch: raffle or first come first served, both via buttons; keys go by DM only and a failed DM returns the key; participation requires a linked GitHub account.
modules.access_keys.name: Key distribution
